en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Dyad on the Sense-Sphere (Kāmāvacaraduka).

Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive belonging to the sense sphere (*kāmāvacara*), there arises a dhamma that is not non-demonstrable and not non-reactive and does not belong to the sense sphere, by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and does not belong to the sense sphere, there arises a dhamma that is not non-demonstrable and non-reactive and does not belong to the sense sphere, by way of root condition; ... pe ... dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and does not belong to the sense sphere...

States that are non-illuminating, non-reactive, and not of the sense-sphere, and states that are non-illuminating, non-reactive, and not of the sense-sphere, arise with root-condition as their condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six for root, six for predominance … pe … three for object … pe … six for non-disappearance.
